# The build script of the test package `someone/native`: compiles its
# `c/add.c` with the clang the build hands it, for the build's target, and
# says to link the object. It counts its runs in `runs.txt` in its output
# folder.

import [File, Path] from io;
import os;
import process;

main(): int {
    var out = Path(os.environment("PEP_OUT_DIR").value());
    var runs = out.join(Path("runs.txt"));
    File.write_text(runs, File.read_to_string(runs).ok_or("") + "run\n");
    var object = out.join(Path("add.o"));
    var compiled = process
        .Command(os.environment("PEP_CLANG").value())
        .arguments(["--target=" + os.environment("PEP_TARGET").value(), "-c", "c/add.c", "-o", object.to_string()])
        .run();
    if (compiled.is_err() or !compiled.value().status.success()) {
        return 1;
    }
    print($"pep:object={object}");
    print("pep:rerun-if-changed=c");
    print("pep:rerun-if-env-changed=NATIVE_TEST");
    return 0;
}
